```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(janitor)
set.seed(42)
```

```{r}
fihtab<- read_csv("data/fish.csv")
geo<-fihtab |> clean_names() |>
  filter(genus=="Geotria")
ggplot(geo, aes(x=total_length_cm)) +
  geom_histogram()+
  ggtitle("Distribution of total length in Geotria fish - Observed") +
  xlab("Total length (cm)") +
  ylab("Number of fish") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Calculate the observed mean and standard deviation
mean_obs <- mean(pull(geo, total_length_cm))
sd_obs <- sd(pull(geo, total_length_cm))

# Draw the plot
ggplot(geo, aes(
  x = total_length_cm
)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),
    bins = 50
  ) +
  stat_function(
    fun = dnorm,
    args = list(mean = mean_obs, sd = sd_obs)
  ) +
  ggtitle("Distribution of total length in Geotria fish  -\nObserved and Theoretical") +
  xlab("Total length (cm)") +
  ylab("Density") +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
neudata <- read_csv("data/neurons.csv")
colnames(neudata)
ggplot(neudata, aes(x=Inter_Spike_Interval))+
geom_histogram(bins=50)

```
```{r}
most_wait<-max(neudata)
most_wait
sample_mean_wait_time <- mean(pull(neudata, Inter_Spike_Interval))
n_observations <- nrow(neudata)
lambda <- 1 / sample_mean_wait_time
```

```{r}
max_w <- c()
for (i in seq_len(1000)){
  ex_data <- rexp(n=n_observations, rate = lambda)
  max_w <- c(max_w, max(ex_data))
}
maxw_df<- tibble(Max_W_Time = max_w)
```
```{r}
ggplot(maxw_df,aes(x=Max_W_Time))+
  geom_histogram(bins=50)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = most_wait, colour="red")
```
```{r}

n_not_bigger <- maxw_df |>
  filter(Max_W_Time <= most_wait)
prop <- nrow(n_not_bigger) / nrow(maxw_df)
print(prop)
```
```{r}
prob_one_wt <- pexp(most_wait, rate = lambda)
print(prob_one_wt)
prob_all_wt <- prob_one_wt^n_observations
print(prob_all_wt)
```
